description: Folder (Matter) CRUD + document upload + ingest status surface (parse_status/ocr_status/extraction_quality/page_count) aligned to the state model and API surface.

userStories.title: Create and open a Matter
userStories.description: Create/list/open a Matter (Folder) to host a diligence pack.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001 POST /folders creates a folder with state=empty.
AC-002 GET /folders lists folders including state and latest_index_version.
AC-003 GET /folders/:id returns folder state and timestamps.

userStories.title: Upload PDFs and observe ingest status
userStories.description: Upload PDFs into a Matter and observe document ingest progress/failures via parse_status/ocr_status and derived folder state.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-004 POST /folders/:id/documents returns a document record plus an upload target (signed URL + headers + storage_key).
AC-005 POST /documents/:id/complete enqueues ingest and document state progresses out of queued as work starts.
AC-006 GET /folders/:id/documents returns documents with parse_status, ocr_status, page_count (when parsed), and extraction_quality (when ocr done).
AC-007 Folder state transitions are monotonic and consistent with the state model (empty->ingesting->indexed->ready; failures -> failed).
